use_case: An electronics-recycling operator schedules pickups at client sites, weighs the recovered material by category, bills a per-pickup service fee, and issues a certificate of destruction per completed pickup.
entry_door: signed-in supabase-js: custom.table_declare / custom.field_declare / custom.record_write, admin@admin.com
note: A generic table-to-table relation field (pickup -> client_site, weight -> pickup, certificate -> pickup) could not be declared through any client-callable door (field_declare has no parity type for it; a direct record_write into the field kernel is refused with FLD-13). Worked around with denormalized text link fields (client_site_name, pickup_ref_link) and a manually-computed total_weight_lbs_manual field in place of a ROLLUP field, which also could not be declared as a result. See common-docs REAL-DATA-LIMITS.md.
